body.message:
This form is for Bayz, as we have not yet received your final confirmation regarding which apartment you would like to stay in. However, that is completely fine.

If you sign this same form, we can move your booking to Urban Oasis with no issue. If you would like to cancel the Bayz booking and switch to Urban Oasis, there will be no cancellation fee. You will only need to add AED 1,000.
